notes: Maker page spec block is labelled 'Latch: 2025'. Shown price $2,095.00 is with the default 10.5Ah battery (the store's product data lists the bike variants at $1,346, apparently before the battery option). Maker spec list gives no class and no throttle; Practical Cycle (Pedego dealer, describes Latch V2 with 500 watt rear drive) lists a twist-and-go throttle, so Class 2. Its battery note (52v x 10ah) differs slightly from the maker's 10.5Ah. EBR's 'Pedego Latch Review' is the 2016 model (36V 250W front hub), so not used.
